head: 0490013e4f67f0d31ccd764a5cb723dcafaf4acd
title: Add sort by modification date option
description: The bookmark list can be sorted by the date a bookmark was added or by title. Add sorting by the date a bookmark was last modified, ascending and descending. The option is available wherever the existing sort options are: the sort dropdown of the bookmark list and the `sort` query parameter of the bookmarks REST API (`GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc` and `sort=modified_desc`), including the archived bookmarks list. Taken from linkding pull request #1363 (upstream commit 0490013).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc returns the user's bookmarks ordered by date_modified ascending
GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_desc returns them ordered by date_modified descending
The bookmark list page offers 'Modified ↑' and 'Modified ↓' in the sort dropdown and selecting one reorders the list accordingly
The archived bookmarks list and its API accept the same two sort values
An unknown sort value still falls back to the default order (added, newest first)
